newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius investment firm NIT 1996 profit surges.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius investment firm NIT 1996 profit surges.

text.p: Investment firm National Investment Trust on Thursday reported profit before tax for the year ending 30 June 1996 at 31.4 million rupees ($1.5 million) from 17.9 million rupees the previous year.

Total income of NIT in 1995/96 rose to 33.1 million rupees from 19.6 million rupees in 1994/95 while profit after tax jumped to 30.7 million rupees from 17.8 million rupees over the same time period, financial results showed.

The results showed that over the past financial year, the value of its portfolio of domestic securities suffered from a decline while its portfolio of overseas securities went up in value. Company officials recently said geographical diversification was high on their agenda.

NIT's portfolio of domestic securities was valued at 672.2 million rupees on 30 June 1996 from 735.3 million rupees one year earlier while the value of its overseas portfolio jumped to 41.2 million rupees from 25.9 million rupees.
Launched in 1993, NIT's initial investments were aimed at enabling the Mauritian public to participate in the shareholdings of state owned companies such as State Bank of Mauritius and Air Mauritius.
